verdict.rationale: Yapily's docs clearly describe payment initiation (single, scheduled, recurring, bulk) via a dedicated Payments API, with local rail settlement mentioned for UK (Faster Payments) and Europe (SEPA), and status tracking via webhooks — a coherent, honestly-scoped payment-initiation product. Missing for 10: an explicit full country/geography coverage list beyond UK/SEPA, and independent or hands-on corroboration of live payment initiation (only first-party docs are cited).
